target.title: fix(openai): redact token exchange error response body
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`response.text()` in the OpenAI Codex token exchange error path embeds the
full response body in the error message.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced raw `response.text()` with `extractProviderErrorDetail` for bounded,
redacted structured error detail. Pattern from #102953.

## User Impact

**Before:** raw body in error message
**After:** redacted structured detail `[code=...]`

## Evidence

### Targeted path proof (OpenAI Codex exchange via extractProviderErrorDetail)

Real HTTP 400 with realistic OpenAI OAuth error body → `extractProviderErrorDetail(response)` in the exact exchangeAuthorizationCode pattern:

```
=== #103567 Proof: extractProviderErrorDetail on OpenAI Codex exchange path ===
Status in message: PASS
Structured code preserved: PASS
Raw JSON keys not leaked: PASS
Structured [code=...] format: PASS
Detail bounded (70 chars): PASS

Message: OpenAI Codex token exchange failed (400): The authorization code is invalid or has expired. [code=invalid_grant]
Detail: The authorization code is invalid or has expired. [code=invalid_grant]

Overall: ALL PASS
```

### Import check

`node --import tsx` — import OK

### Diff

```
extensions/openai/openai-chatgpt-oauth-flow.runtime.ts | 6 +++--
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
